assessment: The authors present an interesting genomics approach to understanding the role of heat shock factor 1 (HSF1) in breast cancer cells. They show that HSF1 indirectly interacts with estrogen receptor α (ERα) by regulating the transcription of HSP90, which is essential for normal folding and function of the receptor. They also show that HSF1 and ERα tether within the genome to enhance the transcription of a subset of genes associated with disease progression. Finally, they show the relevance to the breast tumors through comparing their data to publicly available data.
